methodologyNotes: Published self-serve shared web-hosting pricing was collected from each provider's own pricing page on the accessed date and re-verified 2026-06-13; the monthlyUsd figure is the advertised promotional introductory rate (which requires a multi-year prepaid term as noted per plan), with the higher post-term renewal rate recorded in notes. Where the official page geolocated outside the USA or rendered prices client-side, the USD figures were corroborated against dedicated 2026 pricing-review sources. Web hosting has no per-minute/per-call usage, so minutesIncluded/callsIncluded/overage fields are null; quote-only or unverifiable tiers are recorded with monthlyUsd null. During adversarial re-verification on 2026-06-13: HostGator was dropped because its live pricing page renders all dollar figures as client-side placeholders ($*/$XX) and the USD numbers could not be confirmed on any provider page; DreamHost's Growth and Scale tiers were dropped because the live shared-hosting page lists only the Launch tier and the corroborating review reported different figures, so only the on-page-confirmed Launch tier was retained.
